methodology.quantile: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1] over successful complete responses
methodology.comparison: smart P50 <= minimum healthy direct P50 AND smart P99 <= maximum healthy direct P99, with zero smart failures; no tolerance
methodology.healthy: chain-ID preflight passed, every requested measured sample succeeded for that workload
methodology.cold: first call per method on a fresh transport; chain-ID preflight warms DNS/TLS/socket pools, and the second method follows the first
methodology.interleaving: seeded shuffled transport and method order each round; one user request per transport in flight
methodology.cohortIsolation: distinct stable AbortSignal per transport isolates viem's global URL/signal batch scheduler; cold calls are serial because internal chain checks do not forward caller signals
methodology.retry: direct HTTP retryCount=0 and timeout=10000ms; smart uses actual variant settings
methodology.failureHandling: raw error timings retained; failed responses excluded from successful latency quantiles; unhealthy endpoints not accepted as a successful baseline
methodology.availabilityCutoff: stop a workload after all first three cold/warmup attempts fail or five consecutive measured failures; incomplete series cannot pass
limitations: Single-machine Bun/Node network measurements are not browser performance guarantees. CORS preflight and response headers are reported, but CORS is not enforced by this runtime.
100 samples give an empirical P99, not strong tail confidence or an SLA guarantee; use 1000+ and repeat across times/regions for stronger evidence.
Concurrent chain workers share this host and public provider rate limits; benchmark load and smart racing may affect measured latency.
Writes and wallet interaction are not benchmarked; no transactions are sent.
Baseline freezes the original public-read options; Blink write-only endpoints are omitted because no benchmark method can use them.
Block responses are checked for valid nonzero quantities and retained for review; this latency experiment does not certify canonicality or head freshness across providers.
